{{Top|leg}}
The '''waza''' was a type of [[Tree/Legends|tree]] that covered much of the surface of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dar'Or]]. The tree was a [[Conifer/Legends|conifer]] that towered more than 200 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] above the planet's surface and sported as many as 1,000 [[Limb/Legends|limbs]]. This created foliage so dense that waza forests blotted out all [[Star/Legends|sunlight]] from the ground beneath them. This prevented other vegetation from growing, creating an environment of [[Fungus/Legends|fungus]] growth instead. At higher elevations, entire ecosystems existed within the branches of the waza trees. The [[Ri'Dar]] [[Species/Legends|species]] evolved in these mid-level elevations and inhabited warrens within the waza trees.
